description: Get Aave V4 reserves with supply/borrow APYs, risk params (collateral factor, caps), and status. Use get_aave_reserves for V2/V3. No API key needed. SIZE: unfiltered this returns every reserve (~31k tokens). Pass `symbols` for a named asset, or `compact: true` for rates only.

compact.description: Return only symbol, address, spoke and APYs. Cuts the payload ~10x.

limit.description: Max reserves to return. Default all.

symbols.description: Only return these asset symbols, e.g. ["USDC","WETH"]. Case-insensitive.

name: get_v4_reserves
